tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Full-text search over essays, field-guide entries, talks, projects, the glossary and the profile page. Returns titles, canonical URLs and the best matching section.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Returns the full Markdown of one entry, with front matter (dates, review status, license). Accepts a catalog id such as jb-jwks or a canonical URL.

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description: Lists findings with their anchor URL, source and review status. Filter by entry id or by words in the finding.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: The site's six topics with descriptions, URLs and entry counts.
